marker.description: Pink paint circle with blue arrows indicating the bregma

main_question: Identify the landmark indicated by the pink circle and blue arrows.
main_explanation: The bregma is the point of intersection of the coronal and sagittal sutures on the superior aspect of the skull.

supporting_question.question: Which two sutures meet at the landmark indicated?
supporting_question.explanation: The bregma is the junction of the coronal suture (anteriorly) and the sagittal suture (posteriorly).

true_false.statement: The bregma is located at the junction of the coronal and sagittal sutures.
true_false.explanation: This is the standard anatomical definition of the bregma.
